name: MIA Dynamics Motors
summary: Mia Dynamics Motors Ltd, an Israeli firm, is dedicated to the research and advancement of technology specifically for compact electric vehicles. Its innovative solutions cater to a diverse array of industries, such as personal mobility, defense and security, agriculture, logistics, city delivery services, and the tourism sector. The company, which operates from its headquarters in Tel Aviv-Yafo, was founded in 1991 and formerly traded under the name GO.D.M Investments Ltd.
